description:
Goal
Confirm and encode the correct native quicksort continuation contract: tuple-field continuations carry delivered field lanes and semantic captures, and may also carry separate physical capability params when reusable-cons transport is live.

Problem being fixed
The failing quicksort tuple-field continuation test treated every native entry param as semantic transport. That is wrong once reusable-cons transport is enabled. The quicksort continuation really has:
- 2 delivered tuple-field lanes from partition/4
- 1 semantic pivot capture
- 1 physical reusable-cons source param

Concrete repro
cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib -- --include-ignored

Root cause
The data model does not become wrong in native lowering. Native continuations intentionally publish hidden physical entry params for reusable-cons capabilities, and quicksort legitimately uses that path because the delivered continuation later rebuilds `[p | qsort(hi)]`. The bug is at the test/expectation boundary: it counted raw entry params and raw `param_reprs` as if they were semantic continuation params.

Design decision
Do not remove the physical param and do not special-case quicksort. Keep the native/data model as-is:
- raw entry params = semantic transport params + physical capability params
- semantic specialization must ignore physical params
- tests for continuation shape must distinguish semantic params from physical capability params

Code seams
- src/compiler2/drive_test.rs quicksort continuation assertion
- any nearby helper/assertion should use `FnIr::semantic_entry_params()` and `physical_entry_params` instead of raw block arity when reusable-cons may be live

Checks
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations --lib
- cargo test compiler2_interp_runs_quicksort_from_backend_artifacts --lib
title: Compiler2 native tuple-field continuations over-publish entry params
